main_text.l: tandem anno M. cccc. lxxvii, pruden-
goa & Ostergoa in fœdus decenne cum
Hæc summa: Id quod anno M. cccc. xxii,

l.i: à totâ gente Frisicâ Groningæ initum fœdus
fuit, ratum sit, salvo nupero fœdere Collu-
mano: Groninganis non licet at hoc decennio
ullam præterea Ostergoæ aut Westergoæ par-
tem fœdere hujusmodi implicare, aut præto-
riæ potestati suæ subjicere: Conventus quo-
tannis agatur alternis vicibus Groningæ &
Leoardiæ, ad quem quini ab utraque par-
te homines sapientes mittantur: hiis x un-
decimus adjiciatur, quem ex Ostergoâ aut
Westergoâ quini Groningani eligent, cùm
conventus agetur Leoardiæ: quini verò
Transflavicani, ex oppido aut agro Gronin-
gano cùm conventus ille Groningæ habebi-
tur. Horum arbitrii sit causas omnes pu-
blicas & privatas, quæ in controversiam ve-
nient, cognoscere, disceptare, definire:
quicquid definiverint, ab omnibus ratum
habeatur: intraque præfixum tempus exe-
cutioni mandetur ab iis apud quos sedes tenet
condemnatus, aut ab ipsis illis multa peta-tur:

page.notes: The running head and the page number are printed in a slightly different type from the body; I have read the final letter of "Groningâ" in the running head as â, which is not fully clear. "xxii," in the date is read from a worn numeral and may be "xxi i" or "xxii". The "s" after "xxii" may be a stray mark. The final line "tur:" is set right-indented after a printed hyphen, so it is kept as "peta-tur:". The paragraph runs on to the next page.
